games.name: Scream Stream [HORROR]
games.desc:
You and your friends land jobs at ScreamStream to make films for viral online success, but things take a dark turn! 💀

You stumble upon a mysterious divebell that transports you to your worst nightmares. Now, you're trapped in a realm of terror where you must keep the cameras rolling. 📷

As you fight to survive, you uncover dark secrets about ScreamStream. Will you make it out alive and reveal the truth? Or will you become just another victim of the company's twisted games? 😱


-----------------------------------------------------------------
For best experience increase volume and use headphones 🎧

🛠 [BETA TESTING] 🛠
This game is currently in beta testing, EXPECT BUGS
There will be much more content and additional updates for this game.
Join our community server to share your feedback and follow the game's progress!
